topic: Google Business Profile: why responding to every review boosts local ranking
caption:
Leaving reviews unanswered is a ranking mistake.
Google treats your response rate as a trust signal.
Reply to every review, good or bad, within 48 hours.
Seven words is enough. Silence is not.
